summary: Tests-writing phase complete at commit c032cad (branch paid/5-replace-hand-written-api-layer-with-a-generated-op-606250): permanent wire-contract regression tests and red-phase generated-OpenAPI-client tests committed with a LID plan documenting the required package layout, operation/schema contract, and contract deltas. No Swift toolchain exists in this container and no lint/test commands are configured, so no Swift test executed locally; macOS CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml 'swift test') is the execution surface. The generated-client tests intentionally fail to build in this red phase ('no such module OpenAPIRuntime / ColorMatchingOpenAPI') because adding package dependencies and the generated module is implementation-run work gated behind paid-tests-approved. Upstream spec from viamin/color_matching#110 was unreachable (GitHub API proxy restricted to this repo), so the spec surface is defined by docs/ios-openapi-generated-client.md and the final prose-vs-published-spec delta list is deferred to the implementation run.
